$comment: TrainEnv configuration (IF-08). A randomised parameter has its nominal value and the range it is drawn from at reset.

max_tilt_deg.note: STARTING VALUE (mechanical design: about ±4 deg). Actual value comes from platform/variables_spec (Module A).

max_tilt_speed_deg_s.note: STARTING VALUE. Actual value comes from platform/variables_spec (Module A).

plate_width_mm.note: STARTING VALUE (mechanical design v4). Actual value comes from measuring the maze plate.

plate_height_mm.note: STARTING VALUE (mechanical design v4). Actual value comes from measuring the maze plate.

ball_mass_g.note: STARTING VALUE (mechanical design). Actual value comes from weighing the ball.

friction_coeff.note: Rolling resistance coefficient. STARTING VALUE. Actual value comes from fitting to recordings.

restitution.note: STARTING VALUE. Actual value comes from fitting to recordings.

latency_ms.note: STARTING VALUE. Actual value comes from measuring the delay (IF-06 delay budget).

step_dt_s.note: STARTING VALUE for nominal. Actual value comes from Vision's camera frame rate.

filter_noise.note: STARTING VALUE (Vision default). Actual value comes from Vision's filter_noise in vision/variables_spec (C.7).

lost_timeout_ms.note: Design value (C.7). Actual value comes from Vision's lost_timeout_ms in vision/variables_spec.

occlusion_rate_per_s.note: Occlusions started per second while the ball is near a wall. STARTING VALUE. Actual value comes from counting is_predicted in recordings.

occlusion_wall_gap_mm.note: Gap between ball and wall face that counts as near a wall. STARTING VALUE. Actual value comes from recordings.

occlusion_min_ms.note: Shortest occlusion (about one camera frame). STARTING VALUE. Actual value comes from recordings.

occlusion_max_ms.note: Longest occlusion; above lost_timeout_ms the ball is lost. STARTING VALUE. Actual value comes from recordings.

frame_drop_chance.note: Chance per step that the camera drops a frame, so the step lasts two frame periods. STARTING VALUE. Actual value comes from Vision's frame timing.

exit_hold_frames.note: STARTING VALUE. Actual value comes from GameManager's exit_hold_frames (Module E).

wall_hit_min_speed_mm_s.note: STARTING VALUE. Actual value comes from Vision's wall_hit_min_speed_mm_s (Module C).

progress_reward_per_mm.note: STARTING VALUE. Actual value comes from tuning in training.

time_penalty_per_s.note: STARTING VALUE. Actual value comes from tuning in training.

wall_hit_penalty.note: STARTING VALUE. Actual value comes from tuning in training.

tilt_change_penalty_per_deg2.note: STARTING VALUE. Actual value comes from tuning in training.
